target.title: fix(discord): guard message handler against malformed gateway dispatch data
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Discord message handler in `extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.ts` accesses `entry.data` and `last.data` properties without null safety, risking crashes at runtime when the gateway dispatches malformed or incomplete MESSAGE_CREATE data. The `shouldDebounce` callback also directly accesses `entry.data.message` without an optional chain, while the handler ingress had no guard to reject dispatches missing essential message data before reaching the debouncer.

Without these guards, a single malformed gateway dispatch event can crash the Discord message processing pipeline (`shouldDebounce` TypeError on undefined `entry.data`), causing message loss and requiring a gateway restart. The ingress guard ensures malformed dispatches are cleanly rejected at the earliest possible boundary.

## Why This Change Was Made

A defensive programming audit identified 4 locations in the message handler where `entry.data` or `last.data` are accessed without null safety. ClawSweeper review further identified that malformed dispatches are not guarded before enqueue — the handler ingress lets malformed data through to `shouldDebounce`, which crashes on `entry.data.message` when `entry.data` is nullish. The review response adds an ingress guard, an optional chain in `shouldDebounce`, and a focused regression test.

## Summary

**Problem:** Malformed Discord MESSAGE_CREATE gateway dispatches with nullish or missing `data` / `message` properties crash the message handler at 6 access sites (buildKey, shouldDebounce, combined text builder, synthetic message, handler ingress). Without fixing all of them, a single bad dispatch can crash the entire pipeline.

**Solution:** Add null-safety (optional chaining and early returns) at all 6 access sites. The handler ingress guard (`if (!data.message?.id) return`) is the earliest rejection point — it prevents malformed dispatches from reaching replay claim, preflight, or the debouncer entirely.

What changed: +6 null-safety guards across `extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.ts`, plus 1 regression test in `message-handler.queue.test.ts`.

What did NOT change: No changes to the gateway mapper (`gateway-dispatch.ts`), preflight logic, inbound replay/dedupe, message run queue, or any other module. No infrastructure files (`pnpm-lock.yaml`, `CHANGELOG.md`) are touched. No new dependencies are introduced.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed:** Add null-safety to Discord message handler so malformed MESSAGE_CREATE gateway dispatches with missing message data do not crash the message processing pipeline.

**Real environment tested:** Local unit test environment with real function exports from `createDiscordMessageHandler` (not mocked internals). The test exercises both the malformed payload rejection path and the valid message processing path through the actual handler function.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
```bash
# node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run <test-file>
run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-discord.config.ts extensions/discord/src/monitor/message-handler.queue.test.ts --reporter verbose
```

**After-fix evidence:**
```bash
# node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run <test-file> 2>&1
 ✓ |extension-discord| ... > handles malformed MESSAGE_CREATE data without blocking subsequent valid messages
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  23 passed (23)
```

BEFORE FIX: A malformed MESSAGE_CREATE payload with no `message` property would crash `shouldDebounce` at `entry.data.message` (TypeError on undefined `entry.data`), blocking all subsequent valid dispatches.

AFTER FIX: The handler ingress guard (`if (!data.message?.id) return`) rejects malformed dispatches before they reach the debouncer. A subsequent valid message processes normally through the same handler. The terminal output confirms all 23 tests pass.

**Observed result after the fix:** All 23 tests pass. The new regression test demonstrates that a malformed MESSAGE_CREATE payload (`{ channel_id: "ch-1" }` with no `message` property) is cleanly rejected by the ingress guard and does not reach preflight or message processing. A subsequent valid message is still processed normally, confirming the guard does not block legitimate dispatches.

**What was not tested:** Real Discord gateway runtime (L3). This PR cannot provide live Discord gateway logs because it requires a running Discord bot with a valid token and real WebSocket connection — the author's setup does not include a Discord development bot environment. The malformed gateway dispatch scenario is a defensive/hypothetical boundary case, not a reproduced production failure. The L2 unit test evidence correctly exercises the real function exports with both malformed and valid data paths.

## Risk checklist

- [x] **merge-risk: 🚨 message-delivery** — Risk: Medium. The diff touches Discord inbound message handling. Mitigation: The ingress guard and optional chains are additive null-safety that only skip malformed dispatches — they cannot introduce new failure paths for valid dispatches. The regression test confirms valid messages still process normally through the same handler.
- [x] Changes limited to `extensions/discord/src/monitor/` — no cross-boundary or infrastructure impact.
- [x] No `pnpm-lock.yaml` or `CHANGELOG.md` changes.
- [x] +40/-1 lines across 2 files (1 source, 1 test), no new dependencies.
- [x] All existing tests pass with no regressions.
- [x] New regression test covers the malformed payload drop path.

## Current review state

ClawSweeper review response: round 1.
- **P1**: Add malformed MESSAGE_CREATE regression test → ✅ Done (`message-handler.queue.test.ts`)
- **P1**: Add real behavior proof → ✅ Done (L2 evidence above)
- **P2**: Guard malformed dispatches before enqueue → ✅ Done (handler ingress + shouldDebounce)

## AI-assisted

This PR was authored with Claude Code. Code changes, test additions, and PR text were produced through an AI-assisted workflow under the pr-killer pipeline.
